It was written by [[Rebecca Roanhorse]] and published by [[Random House Worlds]] on [[September 15]], [[2026]]. An [[Reign of the Empire: Edge of the Abyss (audiobook)|audiobook version]] was released along side the novel. It is set in [[6 BBY]], one [[Standard year|year]] before the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''.
